race.title: Virgin Bet Supports Safer Gambling Nursery
race.verdict: A combination of 7f and heavy ground may have just been too much of a test for RESEMBLANCE at Haydock last time but it was by no means a bad effort in third. She can quickly regain the winning thread, perhaps at the chief expense of the likeable Bladey Lady and My Boo Boo . RESEMBLANCE (IRE) BLADEY LADY (IRE) MY BOO BOO
